banking-economy.title: CBI arrests senior IAS officer Pankaj Aggarwal in ongoing alleged IDFC First Bank fund misappropriation case
banking-economy.summary: The Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI) has arrested Pankaj Aggarwal, IAS on Monday who was the then Principal Secretary in Department of School Education and Agriculture, in connection with the misappropriation of government funds from the account of Haryana School Shiksha Pariyojna Parishad (HSSPP) and Haryana State Agriculture Marketing Board (HSAMB) maintained with the Sector 32, Chandigarh branch of IDFC First Bank.

sectors.title: Meta's Cred deal showcases new playbook: take stake, hire the founder
sectors.summary: Meta is strategically acquiring minority stakes in tech firms and integrating their founders into senior roles, a pattern evident with Cred and Scale AI. This "acquihire" approach allows Meta to rapidly gain specialised talent and influence, bypassing lengthy onboarding processes and regulatory hurdles of full acquisitions. While founders benefit financially and startups continue operations, Meta secures key expertise for its AI and messaging platforms.

sectors.title: Ola Electric gets BIS certification for indigenous LFP battery cell
sectors.summary: Ola Electric's subsidiary has secured Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS) certification for its indigenously developed 46100 lithium iron phosphate (LFP) battery cell. This marks a first for an Indian company in this cylindrical format. The new cell, designed for both electric mobility and energy storage, expands their in-house battery portfolio and aims to reduce reliance on imported technologies.

sectors.title: NCLT posts Byjus-Aakash hearing for July 16 as parties seek time for settlement
sectors.summary: Aakash Educational Services and Think & Learn's resolution professional requested a delay in NCLT proceedings, citing advanced settlement talks for the Aakash shareholding dispute.
